title: Continuous Improvement — operating knowledge
content: Strategy, Performance & Evolution must understand continuous improvement as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Continuously improve company design, cost, workflows, capabilities and outcomes using measured experiments and controlled change. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: The company becomes measurably more effective, reliable and cost-efficient each month. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: The company becomes measurably more effective, reliable and cost-efficient each month.

title: Continuous Improvement — how the department uses it
content: When work involves continuous improvement, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: The company becomes measurably more effective, reliable and cost-efficient each month.

title: Continuous Improvement — controls and boundaries
content: For continuous improvement, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: The company becomes measurably more effective, reliable and cost-efficient each month.
